name: BSP_MissionEntity_CreateLuaSelfTable
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = entity), body 00928A00-00928C79, sole caller 0077E830. Formats the u16 at entity+174h into a decimal key (00928A2F -> 004260B0), caches it as a NativeString at entity+178h (00928A54/00928A6A), reads the current slot through 00927B40, clears a non-nil slot (00928AFF -> 00B67350 set-nil), assigns a fresh table (00928B53 -> 00B67580), then seeds self.ID = key as a string (00928BA5 -> 00B67630), self.Dead = false (00928BC7 -> 00B673A0 lua_pushboolean 0) and self.Ptr = lightuserdata(entity) (00928C2F -> 00B67530 -> 00A67BE0). The 00928AB4 branch (entity+C0h with kind 3) is unread. docs/MISSION_LUA_SELF_TABLE.md. | Correction and completion (cc2_entity_lua_attach): 00928A00 is not reached only from 0077E830. It IS entity virtual slot 39 (+9Ch) of the root entity vtable 00CE6290, and 0077E830 is a derived override of the same slot that calls it directly at 0077E834. 43 vtables install a slot-39 attach: this one, 17 that take 0077E830 unchanged, and 25 behind the nine further overrides (004426C0 006D0C80 00743450 00743E90 0074CCF0 007CDF20 007F4580 00810F60 008429E0), so 21 named vehicle classes from docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_DESCRIPTORS.md all reach it. The 00928AB4 kind-3 branch is now read: 00928AB8 JZ 00928BEE jumps into the Ptr sequence the fall-through also reaches, so kind 3 SKIPS the IsNil test, the stale-slot clear, the fresh-table assign, ID and Dead, and rebinds only Ptr. The key at entity+178h is refreshed either way because 00928A2F-00928A6A run before the test. docs/MISSION_ENTITY_LUA_ATTACH.md.

evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall(controller, float commanded_speed, float dt) RET 8. Rewrites the body's linear velocity toward a commanded forward speed with an acceleration limit; commanded thrust is kinematic, not a force. dir is the body axis flattened to the horizontal (the y term is a literal 0.0f/len at 0092D3B7), target = (1-|axis.y|)*commanded, accel from 00825EC0 unless one of three class[504h] cases fires, move = accel*dt bites only while it is no larger than the gap, then 00C37E50. Sole caller 00825F20. docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md
